description: This file implements the DigitalProductService interface, providing methods for managing digital products, including adding files, retrieving by product, deleting, and saving or updating digital products. It interacts with DAOs, content managers, and product services, and is part of the catalog product service layer.

classes.name: DigitalProductServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing digital products, handling file addition, retrieval, deletion, and update, ensuring proper interaction with DAOs, content managers, and related services.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Associates a digital file with a product, uploads the file, marks the product as virtual, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a digital product associated with a specific store and product.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a digital product, removes its associated file, and updates the product status.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new digital product or updates an existing one, and marks the product as virtual.
